defaults.composition: Close view of one flower clump or grass texture in the lower two-thirds of the frame at a low side angle, with the meadow and trees behind softly out of focus so the wider setting stays readable, framed at a natural arm's-length distance.

shots.subject: A few meadow buttercups and fresh grass blades rising above clover leaves at the edge of a sunny meadow, a hawthorn hedge blurred far behind
Dew drops on young grass blades and a single nodding cowslip stem on a meadow bank, a hazy hedge and pale sky softly behind
shots.motion_elements: the grass blades and the cowslip

shots.subject: Backlit seed grasses with a few ox-eye daisies at the edge of an open meadow, warm light on the stems and a dark beech wood edge behind
A small clump of cuckooflowers in damp meadow grass, pale lilac heads on thin stems and a gray-green meadow with willows blurred behind
Rain-beaded red clover heads and grass blades in a hay meadow, tiny droplets on the leaves and a misty meadow with hedges behind
Queen Anne's lace umbels at the edge of a meadow against a soft blue sky, fresh grass below and a green hawthorn hedge blurred behind
Young bracken fronds uncurling among white wood anemones at the edge of a clearing, fresh grass around them and haze in the trees behind
shots.motion_elements: the bracken fronds and the anemones

shots.subject: A cluster of red campion in tall fresh grass on a sloping meadow, low sun rimming the petals and a soft green hillside behind
A few snake's-head fritillaries nodding in damp floodplain grass, checkered purple bells on thin stems and a line of poplars softly behind
Wet bluebell stems and small beech seedlings at the edge of a wood, droplets on the leaves and mist hanging between the trunks behind
shots.motion_elements: the bluebell stems and the mist

shots.subject: A tuft of fresh meadow grass with a few daisies and dandelions on a gentle slope, the open meadow and a single oak blurred behind
shots.motion_elements: the grass tuft and the daisies

shots.subject: Dandelion seed heads standing in dewy meadow grass, soft pale light on the silvery clocks and a fresh green willow bank blurred behind
Meadow foxtail grass heads and a few buttercups in warm side light along a field margin, white hawthorn blossom blurred in the hedge behind
Pale yellow primroses at the foot of a mossy bank, damp fresh grass around their leaves and an oak trunk softly blurred behind
shots.motion_elements: the grass blades around the primroses

shots.subject: Marsh marigolds beside a small trickle of water crossing a meadow, wet glossy leaves, a few mossy stones and a green meadow blurred beyond
shots.motion_elements: the trickling water and the marigold leaves

shots.subject: A sprig of blackthorn blossom over fresh meadow grass at the edge of a hedgerow, a sunlit field and soft blue sky behind
shots.motion_elements: the blossom twig and the grass
